CustomField.label: CX Milestone
CustomField.description: Marks an activity as a customer lifecycle milestone rather than a day-to-day interaction. Defined on Activity so the single definition applies to both Task and Event. Read by the navexCxTimeline component when its "Lifecycle Milestones Only" property is on.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick this to place the activity on the account's CX Timeline as a lifecycle milestone.
